description: 5-star penthouse of 290 m² on Avenue Foch, with large terraces and breathtaking views of the Arc de Triomphe. On the 6th and top floor, accessible by lift, it has four bedrooms, including a stunning children's bedroom decorated with care, three bathrooms, two living rooms, a dining room and three WCs. Designed by a great architect with exceptional finishes: mouldings, spectacular ceiling heights and Hungarian parquet flooring. A rare and exclusive place.Parties are not allowed.The space📍 Stay at one of Paris' most prestigious addresses: Avenue Foch. Located in the very chic 16th arrondissement, a stone's throw from the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Élysées, this sumptuous 5★ apartment welcomes you in an exclusive, peaceful and central setting 🌟✨ The apartmentOffering 290 m² of absolute luxury, this exceptional property includes:🛏️ 4 elegant bedrooms, including a beautifully decorated children's room🛁 3 spacious bathrooms🛋️ 2 bright living rooms🍽️ 1 refined dining room🚽 3 independent toilets🌇 Two large terraces with spectacular views of the Arc de Triomphe🏛️ Breathtaking decorDesigned by one of the greatest French architects, the apartment combines the charm of the old and contemporary comfort: • Original moldings • Hungarian parquet flooring • Spectacular ceiling heights • High-end furniture and finishes🌆 Ideal locationOn foot, you can easily reach: • The Arc de Triomphe & the Champs-Élysées (3 min) • The Eiffel Tower (10 min) • Bois de Boulogne for your morning walks or jogs🚇 Metro, RER, bus, taxis: everything is accessible in a few steps🛎️ Perfect for an unforgettable stay in ParisWhether you're coming for a family trip, a romantic getaway or an exceptional business trip, this accommodation is an invitation to experience Paris differently – in a haven of calm, beauty
